Container.Name: orca-ide
Container.Overview: Headless Orca server (orca serve). Pair from the Orca desktop app via Settings - Remote Orca Servers using the pairing URL in the container log. Keep it on your LAN/Tailscale; never expose the port publicly.

Config.Name: Pairing address
Config.Description: Address clients dial, e.g. the server's Tailscale IP

Config.Name: Home
Config.Description: Orca state, agent CLIs, credentials and repos. Must be owned by 99:100.
